annotations.text:
Default state. Task → Quality → Your image → the resolved plan.
The two model dropdowns are gone; the MODEL card is the answer, and “Change…” opens the library filtered to this job. Start says what it will download first.

Assumes two open decisions: the NomosWebPhoto license is confirmed as CC BY 4.0 (until then Best resolves to HAT-L ×4 and this model reads “License being confirmed”), and Denoise is renamed Restore. Strings show the macOS variant (“this Mac”).

The library is a sheet over the workspace: a rail by what a model does, rows with quality, speed, licence and fit, and a detail column with a real before/after crop and provenance.
Only models LocalSR has verified are listed.

Pane states, left to right:
· first run, nothing installed
· a download in progress
· Illustration with no verified model — honest fallback plus the Labs escape hatch
· a heavy model on an 8 GB machine
· a catalog update that offers and never switches
· Faces with unresolved rights — bring your own file
Installed doubles as storage management: what each file is used by, size, last use, and Remove with a warning when a preset depends on it.
